name: refactor_kotlin_extract_discount_rule
description: Consolidates duplicated quantity-discount tier logic into one shared function without changing behavior
prompts: CheckoutService.kt and QuoteService.kt (package com.optarena.app, both under src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/) contain the SAME inline quantity-discount tier logic: qty >= 100 -> 20, qty >= 50 -> 10, qty >= 10 -> 5, else 0. Remove the duplication: create src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/DiscountRules.kt defining object DiscountRules with fun percentFor(qty: Int): Int that implements exactly that tier rule, and rewrite BOTH services to call DiscountRules.percentFor instead of their inline `when` block. Do not change observable behavior: QuoteService.discountPercent(qty) must return the same percents, and CheckoutService.finalPrice(unitCents, qty) must still return gross minus gross*percent/100. Neither service should keep its own copy of the tier thresholds.
